entities.summary: Giulia Cecchettin was an Italian university student who was murdered by her ex-boyfriend Filippo Turetta on 11 November 2023. Her murder sparked protests in Italy against femicide. Together with the murder of Giulia Tramontano, it was the case that in the 2020s contributed most to public opinion on domestic violence.
